description: État d'avancement du déploiement du réseau Anjou Fibre is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Département de Maine-et-Loire. Status of the deployment of the FTTH in Maine-et-Loire by the Anjou Fibre network. For data on the status of the zone: Works planned for 2023 Works in progress (20-40 %): 20-40 % of the work is carried out Works in progress (40-60 %): 40-60 % of the work is carried out Works in progress ... Coverage: Département de Maine-et-Loire. The portal shows the English title as "State of play of the deployment of the Anjou Fibre network" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Département de Maine-et-Loire. Its keywords include fibre-optique, ffth, reseau, urbanisme-logement. The listing shows 4 download or service links in JSON, ZIP, CSV. The listing shows 2023-02-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
